ports.name: api_v2
ports.note: Classic BTMiner TCP API (JSON line). Privileged cmds AES-encrypted when apiswitch off for plain write.

ports.name: api_v2_alt
ports.note: Some FW expose alternate privileged port.

ports.name: api_v3
ports.note: API v3 length-prefixed JSON (LE u32 + body). get.device.info / set.miner.*

ports.name: tools_remote
ports.note: WhatsMinerTools Remote Ctrl — proprietary (often 16B challenge first). Main path when public API off.

ports.name: http
ports.note: LuCI/web over plain HTTP if open.

ports.name: https_tcp
ports.note: TLS TCP tunnel only (ciphertext). Point Tools/browser at https://LAPTOP:8443 — SNI/Host may break; prefer hosts-file + listen 443 with sudo if needed.

ports.name: https
ports.note: Requires sudo / admin on Mac. Enable to intercept Tools HTTPS without port remap.
